notes: Yesterday's fix landed. Four other things were hiding it.
he_was_right_and_wrong_about_why: The brand screenshot already said STORE VISIT and 'No time suggested yet' — exactly the planning state yesterday's change was meant to produce. Four separate faults were stacked on top of it.
fault_1_mine_from_yesterday: The creator hero read hasShoot = physical_delivery || data.production_event, and production_event was NEVER in that payload. So hasShoot was always false and a creator with a store visit to attend was told 'You are live' and shown no way to reach it.
fault_2_oldest_and_worst: 'logistics' has never been in the hero's label map. Stage 4 gave the shoot an action and wired it in go(); nobody gave it words. Since the day Stage 4 shipped, the one button that opens the shoot has rendered as a BLANK GREY RECTANGLE — visible in his screenshot. A test has asserted every hero action is WIRED since Stage 3, and passed the whole time, because being wired and being legible are different questions.
fault_3_the_same_mistake_twice: Both shoot screens ran setRange(dates?.data) where the endpoint answers { range: {...} } — one level too few. range came out as the wrapper, truthy, so the card drew with earliest and latest undefined. 'PICK ANY DAY BETWEEN [blank] and [blank]', identically on both phones.
fault_4_the_window_is_genuinely_empty: Verified by running the real service against his contract: post due 30 Aug, a visit must finish 2 days before = 28 Aug, earliest bookable = tomorrow 30 Aug. Latest lands BEFORE earliest and no day satisfies both. It was returned as an ordinary range and nobody could book. Now: impossible=true plus a sentence naming the posting date as the thing to move — the fix is a human moving it, and only a person told about it can.
the_diary_is_not_a_bug: His screenshot shows 'Mode set to remote / Remote mode auto-completed' still listed. That is history and it is correct. The event was repaired; the record of what happened to it is not rewritten. A diary that edits its own past is worth nothing.

verification.against_production: getVisitDateRange run against his real contract returns impossible=true with the sentence naming the posting date.
verification.my_four_new_checks_passed_while_not_exis: ⚠️ The block was inserted through a helper whose newline argument was undefined, so the whole thing landed as ONE LINE. Everything after the first // was commented out. The file parsed, the suite went green, and the four cases never registered. Only the mutation run caught it — 9 mutations, 7 SURVIVED — because the test count looked normal and no assertion failed, there being no assertions. Re-inserted line by line, with the script asserting the lines landed as separate lines before it would write. Eighth time this session a check proved to be testing nothing, and the first time the check did not exist at all.
verification.the_check_that_asked_the_wrong_thing: collabDetailModel.test.js has asserted every hero action is WIRED since Stage 3. It now also asserts every emitted action HAS WORDS ON IT, read out of the screen's own label map.

carried_not_fixed: The brand cannot move the posting date from the shoot screen — the message tells them what to change, they change it where posting dates live
cancelInfluencer still writes an invalid campaign_influencer_status
scope_excluded: Changing the two-day buffer — a real rule; this makes it visible, not weaker

release.outward_facing: Every shoot becomes reachable and every date window becomes readable. Nothing is written.
release.device_walk_required: YES — her collab should say 'The shoot' with 'Plan the shoot' written on the button; the brand's window should say 'No day works' and name the posting date.
